desc: Parse a URL query string. Split s on "&" into items and skip empty items (from "&&" or a leading or trailing "&"). In each item, the key is the text before the first "=" and the value is everything after it (it may contain more "="); an item with no "=" is a key with value "". Then replace every "+" with a space in both key and value. If a decoded key is empty, stop and return the error "empty key: " followed by the original item. Return the (key, value) pairs in order, keeping duplicates.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
